title: Undo after bringing in Hevy or Strong workouts does not stick for a member signed in to MettleUp
what: After an import that replaces the phone's workouts (or removes the demo), the screen offers Undo and promises everything goes back exactly as it was. Undo puts the phone back from the copy taken before the import, but the same step forgets what the phone already sent to the member's MettleUp account and asks for a bring-back first. The background copy sends the imported workouts to the account seconds after the import, so the bring-back writes them onto the phone again. The member ends with the old workouts and the imported ones together, while the screen said the import was undone. This is the same weakness as undoing a backup restore, reached from the import screen.
expected: After Undo, the imported workouts are gone from the phone and from the member's saved copy on MettleUp, and stay gone.
who: members signed in to a MettleUp account who import from Hevy or Strong with Replace (or over the demo) and then tap Undo
how_often: every such undo made after the background copy has run, which is seconds after the import while online
fix_line: Pause the background copy while Undo is on screen, or have Undo also remove the imported workouts from the saved copy instead of asking for a bring-back

evidence: data-count: Crispy Curves gym_body_measurements = 0 rows, so trainer measures on Body were traced in code only

items.reason: the only AI screen here (coach chat, nutrition) is switched off in the build and redirects to the Workout tab
no AI answer is shown on these screens while the coach switch is off
nothing is sent to an AI company from these screens while the coach switch is off
these screens exchange no data with the watch; the Workout tab only shows an install-on-watch card
